name: Rio 2 Seater Metal Balcony Bistro Table and Chairs Set

description.mood_line: Breathe fresh air into your balcony with a touch of forest green elegance.
description.intro: The Rio 2‑Seater Metal Balcony Bistro Set blends a foldable, compact silhouette with a forest‑green powder‑coated iron frame.
description.story: Its table, 60 cm in diameter and 72 cm high, sits on a sturdy, rust‑resistant iron base finished with a UV‑resistant electrostatic coating that keeps the green hue vibrant. Each chair measures 42 cm wide, 45 cm deep, and 85 cm tall, offering comfortable seating while the lightweight frame folds flat for effortless storage. Together, the set occupies minimal footprint, making it ideal for balconies, verandas, and garden terraces.
description.close: Invite family and friends to share moments of outdoor serenity, anchored by the Rio’s resilient design.

name: Bali Woven Synthetic Rattan Outdoor Hanging Swing Chair

description.mood_line: Suspend your senses in a breezy embrace of open-air tranquility.
description.intro: The Bali Woven Synthetic Rattan Outdoor Hanging Swing Chair presents a compact, space-conscious silhouette designed to anchor leisure in compact balconies and garden terraces.
description.story: Crafted from weather-resistant synthetic PE rattan and a rust-resistant powder-coated steel stand, the Earthy Mocha finish blends seamlessly with natural surroundings. The heavy-duty suspension spring ensures stable, smooth motion, while the water-repellent padded cushion offers breathable comfort for extended outdoor relaxation.
description.close: Let the Bali swing transform your outdoor nook into a refreshing sanctuary of domestic calm.
